t: This is Tedworth Square, a garden square in Chelsea, SW3. At its centre is a communal garden of just under a fifth of a hectare. One person who lived here, from 1969 to 1985, was Annabelle Neilson. She became a British socialite, model, author and television personality, and she was the primary muse of the fashion designer Alexander McQueen. In 2014 she also became known in America as a cast member of the reality series Ladies of London.
